name: jackson-robot-run
description: Jackson Robot Run - An endless runner game built with Phaser 3

scripts.deploy: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function cpR(s,d){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const e of fs.readdirSync(s,{withFileTypes:true})){const sp=path.join(s,e.name),dp=path.join(d,e.name);e.isDirectory()?cpR(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}cpR('dist',path.resolve(__dirname,'..','game'));console.log('Deployed dist/ -> ../game/ — commit and push master to publish.')"

author: Cody Raffensperger
